##### Project general facts

Ramhan Island Villas is an exclusive waterfront villa development by Eagle Hills, located in Abu Dhabi and offering an exceptional collection of 3 to 7-bedroom residences. The project is designed to deliver a premium island lifestyle, where contemporary architecture blends seamlessly with the natural coastal surroundings. Each villa reflects a refined modern aesthetic, enhanced by open layouts, elegant proportions, and a strong connection to the sea and landscape.

The development offers a curated selection of world-class amenities focused on wellness, leisure, and outdoor living. Residents can enjoy tranquil wellness spaces surrounded by lush greenery, landscaped outdoor areas, and dedicated zones for relaxation and recreation. A private beachfront experience forms the highlight of the community, allowing residents to enjoy the sea, water features, and serene natural surroundings in a secure and exclusive environment.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including marble flooring in main living areas, engineered wood in bedrooms, and ceramic tiles in utility spaces and bathrooms. Solid wood entrance doors and stained veneer internal doors add a premium touch throughout the villas. The kitchens are fully equipped and included, while the units are delivered unfurnished, with added provisions such as air conditioning units, water heaters, cabinets, wardrobes, and walk-in closets, ensuring both comfort and practicality.

##### Location description and benefits 

Ramhan Island is an exclusive natural island located off the coast of Abu Dhabi, offering a rare blend of seclusion, waterfront living, and close proximity to the city’s main attractions. Surrounded by pristine waters and untouched mangroves, the island provides a peaceful escape from the urban environment while still maintaining convenient access to Abu Dhabi mainland via well-connected road links.

The location is positioned within a serene coastal ecosystem, where residents can enjoy uninterrupted sea views, natural beaches, and a calm island atmosphere. Its strategic setting allows easy reach to key destinations such as Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, and Abu Dhabi International Airport, making it both a private retreat and a highly accessible address.

Ramhan Island is designed as a premium lifestyle destination, combining luxury waterfront living with nature-inspired surroundings. The area is envisioned as a low-density, high-end community focused on privacy, exclusivity, and outdoor living, where residents can experience a resort-style environment year-round.
